about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Punch Champs, a tactical brawler that challenges you to knock out your opponents and ascend the ranks to claim the title of the GOAT. This swift-paced platform fighter blends strategic combat with dynamic environments, ensuring no two battles are ever the same.

⚠️ Demo Limitations – What’s Available Now vs Full Game

The full game is planned to include Online PvP, Cross-Platform Multiplayer, Achievements, Stats, Leaderboards and full controller support (Xbox and PlayStation).

🎮 BEST PLAYED WITH A CONTROLLER

Punch Champs is best played with a controller, offering precise input and responsive gameplay.

🧠 SIMPLE, DEEP AND STRATEGIC

Simple controls meet deep strategic gameplay. Whether you're stepping into the ring for the first time or you're a seasoned brawler.

🥊 CONTEXTUAL COMBAT SYSTEM

Experience the easy fight system, punches adapt in real-time based on your movement, creating fluid and responsive combat.

⚡ POWER-UP SHOWDOWN

Elevate your battle tactics with an arsenal of power-ups! Each match is your arena to strategically unleash power-ups and turn the tide in your favour.

💥 ULTIMATE KNOCKOUT THRILLS

Experience the rush of every knockout! Each KO showcases your skill and power, delivering peak satisfaction as your opponent hits the ground.

🛡️ DANCE OF DEFENCE

Hone your timing with our intricate parry system, allowing you to absorb and counter with devastating effects.

↔️ PUSH-BACK PLAY

Master the strategic push-back mechanic to control the battlefield. Use it to maintain distance or cunningly push adversaries into environmental hazards or off the arena.

short_description: PUNCH CHAMPS is a tactical 2D brawler where every move counts. Master one-hit KOs, parries and dodges because precision is your path to victory. Customise your fighter, outsmart your rivals and rise to GOAT status in this boxing showdown!
